```{r}
library(here)

library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
SVI <- read_csv(here("California_county_SVI.csv"))
asthma <- read_csv((here("current-asthma-prevalence-by-county-2015_2022.csv")))
AQI <- read_csv(here("daily_aqi_by_county_2025 2.csv"))
```

```{r}
SVI_clean <- SVI %>%
  subset(select = -c(STATE, ST_ABBR, LOCATION, M_TOTPOP))
```

```{r}
asthma_clean <- asthma %>%
  filter(`AGE GROUP` == "All ages")
```
